nios-board.institution_type: National Open Schooling / Open and Distance School Education Institution

stream_1.description: Online admission for all learners in Secondary and Senior Secondary for April/May and October/November Public Examinations.

stream_2.description: Online admission for learners who appeared but could not clear or were eligible but could not appear in Public Examination of recognized boards for October/November.

stream_3.description: On-Demand Examination System (ODES) at Secondary level throughout the year.

stream_4.description: On-Demand Examination System (ODES) at Senior Secondary level throughout the year.

certification_rules.passing_criteria: Minimum 33% marks in aggregate as well as separately in theory and practicals (where applicable)
certification_rules.toc_facility: Transfer of Credit (TOC) up to two subjects allowed from recognized boards

public_examination.frequency: Twice a year (Block 1: April-May, Block 2: October-November)

on_demand_examination.frequency: Conducted round the year at HQ and Regional Centres except during Public Examination months
on_demand_examination.flexibility: Learner chooses date and examination venue

assessment_components.tma_policy: Tutor Marked Assignment (TMA) carries 20% weightage in theory marks for Stream 1 learners, providing continuous self-evaluation.
assessment_components.practical_component: Mandatory separate passing in practical examinations for practical subjects (Science, Data Entry, Painting, Home Science, etc.).

class_9.service_type: Preparatory foundation study towards Secondary Course
class_9.progression_to_class_10: Learners above 14 years age are eligible for direct admission to NIOS Secondary Course.

class_11.service_type: Preparatory foundation study towards Senior Secondary Course
class_11.progression_to_class_12: Learners with verified Secondary Pass and minimum 15 years age pursue Senior Secondary Course directly.

secondary_course.official_scheme: Open and Distance Learning Secondary Scheme

senior_secondary_course.official_scheme: Open and Distance Learning Senior Secondary Scheme

secondary_to_senior_secondary.prerequisite: Secondary / Class 10 passing certificate from NIOS or any recognized Board of School Education
secondary_to_senior_secondary.rule: Direct admission to Senior Secondary is strictly prohibited. Learner must have successfully passed Secondary examination.
secondary_to_senior_secondary.gap_requirement: To obtain Senior Secondary certificate in all subjects, a minimum gap of two years is required from the year of passing Secondary.

class_9.service_type: Academic Foundation, RBSE Syllabus Notes, Continuous Assessment & Practice

progression_to_class_10.rule: Promotion to Class 10 requires minimum 33% in each subject and satisfactory attendance (minimum 75%) along with continuous comprehensive evaluation (CCE).

class_10.service_type: Public Board Examination, Verified Practice, Model Papers & Revision Compendiums
class_10.scheme_of_examination: 6 Papers Scheme (Hindi, English, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Third Language). Total Marks per Subject: 100 (80 Board Theory Exam + 20 Sessional/Internal Assessment).

class_11.service_type: Senior Secondary Stream Foundation, RBSE Curricular Studies & Practice

progression_to_class_12.rule: Promotion to Class 12 requires passing Class 11 internal annual exam in chosen stream (Science, Commerce, Arts, Agriculture) with minimum 33% marks separately in theory, practical, and sessional.

class_12.service_type: Public Board Examination, Stream-wise Preparation, Blueprint Practice & Full Exam
class_12.scheme_of_examination: Compulsory subjects (Hindi Compulsory, English Compulsory) + 3 Stream Elective Subjects. Non-practical subjects: 80 Theory + 20 Sessional = 100. Practical subjects: 56 Theory + 14 Sessional + 30 Practical = 100.

passing_rules.separate_passing_required: Must secure minimum 33% separately in Board Theory, Sessional Assessment, and Practicals (where applicable).
passing_rules.grace_marks: Permissible up to 1% of total marks in maximum two subjects as per RBSE examination regulations.

private_candidates_form_17.focus: External candidates appearing for SSC / HSC without regular school enrollment

class_improvement_scheme.focus: Two consecutive attempts allowed to improve division/percentage after passing

bifocal_vocational_stream.focus: 200 marks practical-oriented vocational subjects (Electronics, Computer Science, Mechanical Maintenance)

divyangjan_concessions.description: Special concessions for 21 categories of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities including scribe, extra time, and alternative subjects

class_9.service_type: Academic Foundation, SCERT Maharashtra Syllabus Notes & Continuous Comprehensive Evaluation

progression_to_class_10.rule: Promotion to Class 10 requires minimum 35% in aggregate and individual subjects under CCE and annual school exam regulations.

class_10.examination_status: Secondary School Certificate (SSC) Public Board Examination
class_10.service_type: Public Board Examination, Practice Quizzes, Model Prashnapedi & Revision Bundles
class_10.scheme_of_examination: Best of 5 policy: Total score evaluated on best 5 subjects out of 6. Theory 80/40 + Internal/Practical 20/10 per subject = 100/50 marks. Total 600 marks evaluated out of 500.

class_11.service_type: Junior College Foundation, Stream Studies & Practice

progression_to_class_12.rule: Promotion to Class 12 requires minimum 35% in each subject (theory and practical separately where applicable) in chosen stream (Science, Commerce, Arts, Vocational).

class_12.examination_status: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Public Board Examination
class_12.service_type: Public Board Examination, Stream-wise Preparation, Blueprint Practice & Full Exam
class_12.scheme_of_examination: Compulsory English + Second Language/IT + 4 Stream Subjects = 6 Subjects (600 marks). Non-practical: 80 Theory + 20 Internal = 100. Practical subjects (Physics, Chem, Bio): 70 Theory + 30 Practical = 100. Maths: 80 Theory + 20 Practical/Internal = 100.

passing_rules.separate_passing_required: Must secure minimum 35% separately in theory and practicals/internal assessment where specified by MSBSHSE regulations.
passing_rules.best_of_five_ssc: Applicable for SSC (Class 10) whereby total percentage is calculated from top 5 highest scoring subjects out of 6.
passing_rules.condonation_grace_marks: Permissible up to maximum 15 grace marks in 1 to 3 subjects to achieve passing standard as per MSBSHSE Rule 40.

mathematics_basic_code_18.blueprint_structure: Focuses on fundamental computations, standard formulas, procedural arithmetic, and direct textbook theorems.

mathematics_standard_code_12.name: Mathematics Standard (ગણિત સ્ટાન્ડર્ડ)
mathematics_standard_code_12.target_students: Mandatory prerequisite for Class 11/12 Science Stream Group A (Engineering) and Group AB.
mathematics_standard_code_12.blueprint_structure: Focuses on rigorous proofs, multi-step algebraic derivations, advanced geometry theorems, and analytical applications.

gujarat_state_open_school_gsos.focus: External and private candidates appearing through GSOS examination framework

supplementary_purak_pariksha.focus: Opportunity for candidates failing in up to two subjects (SSC) or one subject (HSC Science) to appear in July supplementary examinations

mathematics_basic_reentry_to_science.focus: Students who passed Mathematics Basic can appear for Mathematics Standard in supplementary exam to qualify for HSC Science Group A

divyangjan_concessions.level: Inclusive Education for Children with Special Needs
divyangjan_concessions.focus: Extra 20 minutes per hour, scribe facility, and alternative questions for visually impaired candidates

class_9.service_type: Academic Foundation, GSEB Question Bank Access, Continuous Assessment & Practice

progression_to_class_10.rule: Promotion to Class 10 requires minimum 33% marks in each subject through annual internal school examination and minimum 75% attendance under GSEB school affiliation norms.

class_10.examination_status: Secondary School Certificate (SSC) Public Board Examination
class_10.service_type: Public Board Examination, Verified Practice, Question Bank & Master Revision Compendiums
class_10.scheme_of_examination: 6 Core Subjects Scheme (First Language, Second Language, Mathematics Basic or Standard, Science & Technology, Social Science, Third Language/Vocational). Total Marks: 100 per subject (80 External Board Theory + 20 Internal Assessment). Total: 600 Marks.

class_11.service_type: Higher Secondary Stream Foundation (Science / Commerce / Arts), GSEB Curricular Studies & Practice

progression_to_class_12.rule: Promotion to Class 12 requires passing Class 11 internal annual exam in chosen stream (Science Group A/B/AB, General/Commerce, Arts) with minimum 33% marks separately in theory and practicals.

class_12.examination_status: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Public Board Examination
class_12.service_type: Public Board Examination, Stream-wise Preparation, Question Bank Alignment, Blueprint Practice & Full Exam
class_12.scheme_of_examination: HSC Science: 100 Marks per subject (50 MCQs OMR + 50 Descriptive Section B/C/D or 70 Theory + 30 Practical depending on format). HSC General (Commerce/Arts): 100 Marks per subject (80 Theory + 20 Internal or 100 Theory as per stream blueprint).

gseb-gujarat.passing_criteria_and_grading: 33% minimum marks in each subject (Theory and Practical/Internal assessed separately) and 33% aggregate. Grades awarded from A1 (91-100) down to D (33-40). Marks below 33% receive Grade E1/E2 (Needs Improvement / Eligible for Supplementary Purak Pariksha).

passing_rules.separate_passing_required: Must secure minimum 33% in Board Theory and Internal Assessment / Practicals separately as mandated by GSEB examination bylaws.
passing_rules.grace_marks: Permissible up to 5 grace marks in aggregate or across maximum 2 subjects to enable eligible candidate to pass.
